# Viyo

> Viyo is a creator-focused video platform where people watch short drama series and creators' videos, and creators can post their work and use AI tools, including one that turns a long video into ready-to-post short clips.

Viyo runs in the web browser at https://www.viyo.site/app/. It is free to join. Some AI tools and later drama episodes use Viyo Coins (earned in the app or bought in packs from $0.99); Viyo Premium is an optional subscription for unlimited drama episodes.

Key facts:
- AI Repurposer: upload a video up to about 30 minutes; get up to 6 vertical 9:16 clips (about 12-60 seconds) with burned-in captions and a hook line. Clip length can be Auto, Short, Medium or Long. First video free (up to 10 minutes), then 40 coins; coins are refunded if no clip is good enough.
- Short dramas: series in short episodes; the first 3 episodes of every series are free.
- Other AI tools: Hook Check, Caption Ideas, Improve with AI, Why This Worked, Voice Consistency Check, AI Video Coach, weekly report, Glow Up (18+).
- Not available yet: Glow Up hairstyle image previews.

- [For creators](https://www.viyo.site/creators): Posting, short drama publishing and AI tools for creators
- [Short dramas](https://www.viyo.site/short-drama): Watching short drama series; first 3 episodes free
- [FAQ](https://www.viyo.site/faq): Pricing, limits, privacy and common questions
- [About](https://www.viyo.site/about): About Viyo and how it treats user content
- [Contact](https://www.viyo.site/contact): How to reach Viyo
